knowledge_graph.title: Credit score
knowledge_graph.description: A credit score is a numerical expression based on a level analysis of a person's credit files, to represent the creditworthiness of an individual. A credit score is primarily based on a credit report, information typically sourced from credit bureaus.

text_blocks.snippet: A credit score is a numerical representation of an individual's creditworthiness, typically ranging from 300 to 850. It reflects how likely a person is to repay borrowed money and make payments on time, based on information in their credit report. Lenders use credit scores to assess the risk of lending money and to determine the terms, such as interest rates, of loans or credit cards.
